text:
Maya R: Quick update — finishing token-cost attribution rollup. Main ask: can infra unblock the latency sample export?
Ajay: On it, saw the PR. There's a failing test in emitter. I'll ping infra-qa.
Samir: PR link: https://git.redwood/instr/PR-421 — failing on timeout in prod-mock. Repro steps:
```bash
go test ./emitters -run TestBatchTimeout -v
```
Ajay: Thanks. I pushed a small fix to backoff, CI green locally, pushing now.
Olivia: Heads up — schema change for event.token.meta added. We need owners for downstream mapping to billing. Schema snippet:
```json
{"event":"token_usage","fields":{"token_count":"int","model":"string","latency_ms":"int","meta":{"user_tier":"string"}}}
```
Paul H: Can the product billing team confirm that user_tier matches our pricing tiers? @Olivia @Maya R
Olivia: Yes — user_tier values: free, pro, enterprise. I'll add to the schema doc and the consent matrix.
Maya R: Ownership: analytics-team owns ingestion and attribution logic; eng-platform owns the latency exporter + schema contracts. Can we add the owners to the ticket?
Ajay: Added Eng-Platform (Ajay) and Analytics (Maya R) to ticket #8742. Also flagged the kv-cache dependency in runtime.
Samir: Runtime dependency note: kv-cache v2 changes key format. If we don't handle prefixing we will double-count tokens for cached responses. I opened PR with migration shim: https://git.redwood/kv/PR-99
Maya R: Thanks. Timeline: want a canary by EOD Friday. If infra can't get the exporter live, fallback plan is to sample 1% via logs and run attribution nightly.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: instr-exporter -> canary on prod-1 at 2026-03-20T18:30Z ; owner: Ajay
Paul H: OK — I'll sync with billing SRE to ensure cost windows align. Anything else?
Ajay: One ask — if anyone sees data gaps after canary, DM me with sample ids. :thumbsup:
